notes.title: Plump! Dumb Frog Pond" Is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you for your incredible support and interest in the game! We're thrilled to announce that Plump! Dumb Frog Pond will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, running from October 14th to October 21st. We invite you to try out the demo and experience the world for yourself![/p][p][/p][p]About the Game: The future is chaos - frog attacks everywhere! You're a frog farmer in Potato Pioneer Town, build pond setups to attract different ugly frogs, then snatch them up in your bucket - Yoink! Toss your catches into tanks, fatten them up, and sell for big bucks.[/p][p]Steam Page: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330100/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you come across any issues or would like to share feedback during the demo, please join our official QQ group to connect directly with the development team. Interested? Add it to your wishlist now![/p]
